title.zh: 【ILITY 网络发生安全事件，目前已暂停跨链桥】
title.en: 【ILITY 网络发生安全事件，目前已暂停跨链桥】

current_state.zh: ILITY reported a security breach and temporarily halted its cross-chain bridge, while on-chain analyst Specter traced a linked wallet that unshielded roughly $41M in ZEC and moved funds via NEAR Intents into Bitcoin and Ethereum, with 4.1M ILY drained from the bridge and about $25M in ZEC still held.
